2115195215179055583.en_summary: $V Visa CFO: US consumer spending remained resilient with no observable deterioration among lower-spending customers. "For the quarter, both US discretionary and non-discretionary spend growth remained strong. Fourth quarter US credit grew 11% year over year, and debit grew 9%. Growth across consumer spend bands remained relatively consistent with prior quarters, with the highest spend band continuing to grow the fastest. We did not see signs of the lower spend consumer weakening in our volumes."
2115195215179055583.zh_summary: $V Visa CFO：美國消費者支出保持韌性，低支出客戶中沒有可觀察到的惡化。「本季度，美國可自由支配和非可自由支配支出增長都保持強勁。第四季度美國信用卡同比增長 11%，借記卡增長 9%。各消費者支出帶的增長與前幾個季度相對一致，最高支出帶繼續增長最快。我們沒有在我們的交易量中看到低支出消費者疲軟的跡象。」
